topic: How does the 11.6% bandwidth of the CTS antenna influence frequency planning and spectral efficiency for broadband satellite links?
consensus_response: The 11.6% bandwidth of the CTS antenna significantly impacts frequency planning and spectral efficiency by restricting available spectrum, increasing inter-beam interference, and necessitating advanced techniques like non-linear beamforming, adaptive modulation, digital channelization, and beam-hopping to optimize resource allocation and minimize interference.
reference_context: SatCom systems require careful frequency allocation and beam management to mitigate interference and maximize throughput within constrained bandwidths.
